title: AgentOnto: Ontology-Guided LLM Agents for Enterprise Data Analytics
abstract: arXiv:2610.23317v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Enterprise data analysis requires agents to connect analytical requests with knowledge distributed across databases, business documents, and existing example tasks. Without an explicit representation of this knowledge, an agent may produce incorrect analytical results and cannot reliably incorporate feedback. We present AgentOnto, an ontology-guided LLM agent for enterprise data analytics. AgentOnto organizes heterogeneous enterprise knowledge into an ontology that directly guides analysis and incorporates confirmed feedback. Iterative Ontology Preparation further improves the ontology through self-generated analysis tasks. We evaluate AgentOnto on two public data sources. AgentOnto substantially outperforms representative methods, while module-level evaluations confirm the effectiveness of ontology construction, analysis, and updating. A real-world deployment further demonstrates its practical value in enterprise analytics. These result

translated_title: AgentOnto：面向企业数据分析的本体引导大语言模型智能体
translated_abstract: 企业数据分析要求智能体能够将分析请求与分布在数据库、业务文档和现有示例任务中的知识相连接。如果缺乏对这些知识的显式表示，智能体可能会产生错误的分析结果，并且无法可靠地整合反馈。我们提出了 AgentOnto，一个面向企业数据分析的本体引导大语言模型智能体。AgentOnto 将异构的企业知识组织成一个本体，该本体直接引导分析过程并整合经过确认的反馈。迭代式本体准备通过自生成的分析任务进一步优化本体。我们在两个公开数据源上对 AgentOnto 进行了评估，结果表明其显著优于代表性方法，模块级评估也证实了本体构建、分析和更新机制的有效性。实际部署进一步展示了其在企业分析中的实用价值。
tldr: AgentOnto 通过将异构企业知识组织成本体来引导大语言模型智能体执行企业数据分析，显著优于现有方法，并通过实际部署验证了其实用价值。
en_tdlr: AgentOnto is an ontology-guided LLM agent that organizes heterogeneous enterprise knowledge into an ontology to guide data analytics, substantially outperforming existing methods and demonstrating practical value in real-world deployment.
